lede: A working copy of a personal dashboard, built with Claude Code and running here on fake data. Click anything; edits are shared and reset daily.

pages.name: home
pages.what: The day at a glance: schedule, tasks, cards, news.
try: Tick a task off today's list
pages.ai: A Claude-written morning briefing; the scheduler refreshes it at 06:00.

pages.name: news
pages.what: Stories grouped across outlets, balanced left to right.
pages.ai: Sonnet writes the digest and cites every line to a story card.

pages.name: checklists
pages.ai: Claude drafts lists from a trip or a prep day.

pages.name: automations
pages.what: Background lanes and what waits on a yes.
pages.ai: Headless Claude runs (claude -p) do the work; nothing ships without a click.

pages.name: mail
pages.what: Inbox by sender: read, sort, summarize, draft. Never sends.
pages.ai: Claude summarizes threads and drafts replies for review.

pages.name: finances
pages.what: Earnings, the transaction book, stocks, who owes what.
pages.ai: Transactions categorized from payee history and email receipts.

pages.name: purchases
pages.what: Buy-or-skip research, seven stages to a verdict.
pages.ai: A research skill fills each stage with sourced findings.

pages.name: trips
pages.what: Trip planner: flights, housing, day-by-day plans.
pages.ai: Fare and stay research skills price options; friends' adds get researched.

pages.name: food
pages.what: Restaurants worth it, with the evidence per score.
pages.ai: Claude scores each place with the sources behind it.

pages.name: recipes
pages.what: A family recipe library: scale it, shop it, cook it.

pages.name: work
pages.what: Shift dashboards: batch prep and bar back.
pages.ai: Prep quantities computed from par levels.

pages.name: jobs
pages.what: Application pipeline: intake, research, interview prep.
pages.ai: A daily sweep scores postings and drafts tailored materials.

pages.name: workbench
pages.what: Specs, plans and design picks to approve or send back.
pages.ai: Every Claude build stops here for sign-off. This demo was built that way.

pages.name: blueprints
pages.what: The shared UI parts, read live off the CSS.
pages.ai: Claude reads these before building any screen.

pages.name: capabilities
pages.what: Every skill on the machine and what it does.
pages.ai: The skills are the AI workflows themselves.

pages.name: inventory
pages.what: Every program on each computer, and how to restore it.
pages.ai: Scanners plus a Claude-kept list of hand-built tools.

pages.name: viewer
pages.what: What Claude shows, full size, and a drop box back.
pages.ai: Claude's screenshots and files land here.

pages.name: vault map
pages.what: Every file in the notes vault, classified.
pages.ai: Claude classified and described each file.
